title: skill-store project manifest (.claude/skills.manifest.json)
description: Skills a project wants linked from the user's skill store. Committed to the project; the links themselves never are.

cap.description: Maximum number of store skills linked into this project at once. Default 8. Linking beyond it unlinks the least recently used skill.

skills.description: Skill names, in the order they were added (earlier = older; used to break LRU ties).
